seo.description: Who SSV Potsdamer Straße is, what it does and how residents are represented.

blocks.title: Who we are
blocks.intro: The SSV is the student self-government of the Potsdamer Straße residence – by residents, for residents.

blocks.heading: What is the SSV?
blocks.body:
The student self-government (SSV) is the elected body of the residents. Everyone living in the residence can have a say, take part in decisions and stand for election.

[Placeholder] Add here since when the SSV exists and on what basis (e.g. statutes) it works.

cards.title: Being your contact
cards.text: We are the first point of contact for questions, problems and ideas about living here.

cards.title: Looking after rooms
cards.text: We take care of the common rooms and their equipment.

cards.title: Celebrating
cards.text: We organise events for all residents.
